items.headline: Leads Commanders to comeback win
items.text: Daniels completed 23 of 35 passes for 289 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions and added six carries for 55 yards in the Commanders' 22-20 win over the Bengals on Monday night.

items.headline: Extends TD streak despite season-low yardage
items.text: McCaffrey rushed 12 times for 49 yards and a touchdown while catching both of his targets for 13 yards in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Vikings.

items.headline: Does little with 11 touches

items.text: Diggs brought in four of six targets for 45 yards in the Commanders' 22-20 win over the Bengals on Monday night.

items.headline: Cleared of head injury
items.text: Head coach Kevin Stefanski said Monday that London was cleared of a concussion near the end of Sunday's 35-13 loss to the Chiefs, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

items.headline: Handles five touches in defeat
items.text: Rodriguez rushed four times for 28 yards in Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants. He added one catch for 13 yards on one target.

items.headline: 'Progressing well,' but likely out Week 12
items.text: Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday that Addison is "progressing really well" in his recovery from thumb surgery, though the wide receiver isn't expected to be available in Week 12 versus the Falcons, Ben Goessling of The Minnesota Star Tribune reports.

items.headline: Season-best effort in win
items.text: Montgomery rushed 26 times for 107 yards and brought in three of four targets for 17 yards in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.

items.text: Chase secured five of nine targets for 31 yards in the Bengals' 22-20 loss to the Commanders on Monday night.

items.text: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Darnold (quadriceps/rib) made a "good bit of progress" over the Seahawks' Week 11 bye and will start Sunday at San Francisco if he fares well during Wednesday's practice, Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.

items.text: Goff completed 20 of 28 passes for 279 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions while adding five rushes for 12 yards in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.

items.headline: Without clear timeline for return
items.text: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said Wednesday that he has no new updates on the status of Conner (foot), who is still "working to return to perform," Tyler Drake of ArizonaSports.com reports. "It was not a good injury," LaFleur said.

items.text: Likely brought in one of three targets for 35 yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.

items.headline: Will maintain larger role sans Nacua
items.text: The Rams are expected to lean more on Mumpfield and the rest of the team's wide receivers in the absence of Puka Nacua (knee/toe), the latter of whom is expected to be sidelined for the remainder of the regular season, Nate Atkins and Jonathan Jones of The Athletic report.

items.headline: Secures 18-yard TD in loss
items.text: Thomas caught one pass for an 18-yard touchdown on three targets in Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants.

items.headline: Helps lead big comeback
items.text: Watson completed 25 of 40 passes for 312 yards with no touchdowns and one interception while adding eight rushes for 49 yards and a score in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Texans on Sunday. He also committed a fumble that remained with Cleveland.
